title: Fix productrev queue head-of-line blocking, optimize syncProductPriceRevenue, getProductsNeedingRevDaily & enrich
acceptance_criteria: Record synced_at and status in sh_product_revsync for ok, no_storefront, no_price, skip, and err so failed top-revenue products never block the productrev queue
Keep queryLocalProducts _normalized flag accurate by checking status IS NULL OR status = 'ok' in sh_product_revsync

Run storefront price/currency lookup and productChartRevenue in parallel, cache storefront currency (with negative/fallback cache), fallback to existing DB price when /products/{handle}.json fails, and parallelize final DB writes
Remove Math.min(8, cfg.concurrency) cap in stepProductrev, increase default productrev config, and optimize getProductsNeedingRevDaily with a sliding revenue_month cursor
